description: 국토교통부_특수교량개요 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 특수교량 정보는 국토교통부 도로시설안전과에서 관리 중인 일반국도 상의 특수교량 33개에 대한 기본정보(교량명, 위치, 차선수)와 각 상세정보(형식, 연장, 교폭, 차선수) 등으로 구성된. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 특수교량, 교량정보, 교량제원, 위치, 시공시작종료. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
